sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Playful illuminated medieval manuscript, like a page from a 14th-century bestiary or a woven tapestry: bold dark ink outlines, flat colour with very little shading, slightly naive proportions, stylised flat perspective and small decorative patterns of vines and stars. Characters are expressive cats dressed as medieval people, standing upright, with big knowing eyes and deadpan faces. Palette: royal blue, crimson, gold leaf, forest green and warm parchment, with dark ink for lines. Gold details have a soft hammered gold-leaf look. Subtle aged parchment grain over everything. Overall mood: charming, regal and quietly silly.
frame: Border: a thick heraldic border in royal blue with hammered gold-leaf edges, a repeating pattern of small gold paw prints and fleurs-de-lis, and gold corner pieces, like the margin of an illuminated manuscript.
Top-left corner: a small heraldic shield emblem in crimson and gold with a single gold paw print on it, with no letters.
Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long unfurled parchment ribbon with a gold edge, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a pale parchment text panel below the window, about a quarter of the card height, with a thin dark ink edge. The upper half of the panel is empty space for flavour text. A thin dark ink divider line runs across the middle of the panel.

Stats row: the lower half of the panel is split into four equal cells by thin vertical dark ink dividers. Each cell has one tiny bold icon hard against its left edge, vertically centred, and every icon is the same size: no wider than a quarter of the cell and no taller than half of the cell. The right three-quarters of every cell is completely empty space for a word like 'NAP POWER' and a large number. The icons, left to right: a tiny silver sword pointing up; a tiny fox mask; a tiny gold crown; a tiny royal-blue 'zzz' at an angle. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in crimson, gold, royal blue, forest green and dark ink.

Card number and rarity: below the panel, on the border, two separate empty badges of the same height. In the bottom-left corner, a wide dark royal-blue plaque with a gold edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#50 of 50'. In the bottom-right corner, a wide pill-shaped pale parchment badge with a gold edge for the rarity, about 25% of the card width, so it can hold a word of nine capital letters. Both are empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only royal blue, crimson, gold, forest green, dark ink and parchment. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime style, no gore, no blood, no real people, no modern objects, no modern vector/flat-design look, no watermarks, no extra text, no blurry or cut-off borders, no real or existing cartoon characters.

rulesCard.title: How to Play
steps: Two players. Deal all the cards evenly.
Each player shuffles their cards into a deck and places it face down.
Each player takes the top card from their deck and looks at it.
The winner of the last round picks the stat to compare. In the first round, the player who most recently took a nap picks.
Reveal the cards. The highest value in the called stat wins.
The winner puts both cards in their own new pile. On a tie, each player puts their own card in their own pile.
When a player's deck runs out, they shuffle their pile to make a new face-down deck.
You win when your opponent has no more cards left. Long live the cat!

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in the style of a playful illuminated medieval manuscript with bold dark ink outlines, flat colour and a subtle aged parchment grain. A design mirrored top to bottom, so it looks the same either way up, with no single upright object in the middle: a thick royal-blue heraldic border with hammered gold-leaf edges and a repeating pattern of small gold paw prints and fleurs-de-lis, around a deep crimson centre panel. In the centre, two crossed swords lying flat on a gold diamond, with a crimson and gold paw-print shield above them and the same shield mirrored upside down below them. Small gold stars and vines fill the rest of the panel. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.

cards.name: Sir Purrcival
cards.character: A ginger tabby knight in dented silver plate armour with a crimson surcoat and a paw-print shield
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing proud with a sword raised, chin up, deadpan and heroic
cards.backgroundScene: A green jousting field with striped tents and fluttering pennants
cards.flavourText: Sworn to defend the realm, except during nap time.

cards.name: Squire Whiskerby
cards.character: A skinny young grey kitten squire in an oversized dented helmet, carrying a pile of armour
cards.poseAndExpression: Staggering under the load, eyes wide, helmet slipping over one ear
cards.backgroundScene: A castle stable yard with hay bales and a patient horse
cards.flavourText: Has dropped every sword he has ever carried.

cards.name: Queen Fluffington
cards.character: A huge white long-haired Persian cat queen in a royal-blue velvet gown, a heavy gold crown and an ermine cape
cards.poseAndExpression: Seated on a golden throne, one paw raised in dismissal, utterly unimpressed
cards.backgroundScene: A grand throne hall with stained-glass windows and heraldic banners
cards.flavourText: She has never once been told no. She would not hear it anyway.

cards.name: Jester Tumblepaws
cards.character: A calico cat jester in a crimson and gold motley suit with a three-pointed belled hat
cards.poseAndExpression: Balancing on one back paw while juggling three balls of yarn, grinning slyly
cards.backgroundScene: A busy banquet hall with long tables and amused nobles
cards.flavourText: Laughs at the king's jokes. Tells better ones when he leaves.

cards.name: Friar Tuna
cards.character: A plump tabby monk cat in a brown habit with a rope belt and a neat tonsure between the ears
cards.poseAndExpression: Blissfully holding up a whole fish with both paws, eyes closed
cards.backgroundScene: A candlelit monastery kitchen with hanging herbs and barrels
cards.flavourText: Took a vow of silence, broken daily at dinner time.

cards.name: Lady Mittens the Bold
cards.character: A black cat with white paws in a green velvet gown worn over chain mail, a longsword at her hip
cards.poseAndExpression: Striding forward with her skirts hitched up, chin high, eyes narrowed
cards.backgroundScene: A misty castle drawbridge at dawn with crows on the battlements
cards.flavourText: Came to the ball in chain mail. Left with three duchies.

cards.name: Archer Fletchwhisker
cards.character: A lean brown tabby archer in a forest-green hood and leather jerkin with a longbow and quiver
cards.poseAndExpression: Drawing the bow with one eye shut, tail held perfectly still
cards.backgroundScene: A dense stylised forest of flat green trees with a straw target
cards.flavourText: Has never missed a target. Has often ignored one.

cards.name: King Mewdred the Mild
cards.character: An old, fat grey British shorthair king in a crimson robe, with a crown slipping over one eye
cards.poseAndExpression: Slumped sideways on a throne, half asleep, sceptre dangling from one paw
cards.backgroundScene: A sunlit royal chamber with a sunbeam falling across the throne
cards.flavourText: His reign is known as the Long Afternoon.

cards.name: Baker Biscuit
cards.character: A cream-coloured cat baker in a flour-dusted apron and a floppy linen cap
cards.poseAndExpression: Kneading dough rhythmically with both front paws, eyes half shut in bliss
cards.backgroundScene: A warm stone bakery with a glowing brick oven and loaves on shelves
cards.flavourText: Makes biscuits all day. Nobody has ever had to teach her.

cards.name: Blacksmith Claw
cards.character: A massive scarred grey tomcat blacksmith in a leather apron with a heavy hammer
cards.poseAndExpression: Hammering a glowing horseshoe on an anvil, jaw set, sparks flying
cards.backgroundScene: A dark forge with glowing coals, bellows and rows of iron tools
cards.flavourText: Forged a sword so sharp it cut the conversation short.

cards.name: The Black Knight of Nine Lives
cards.character: An enormous black cat knight in spiked jet-black plate armour with a tattered crimson cloak and glowing gold eyes
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing in a wide stance with a two-handed greatsword planted in the ground, unblinking
cards.backgroundScene: A burning battlefield at dusk with broken lances and circling crows
cards.flavourText: Has died eight times. Found all of them restful.

cards.name: Sister Purrpetua
cards.character: A thin Siamese nun cat in a black and white wimple with a rosary and a heavy book
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering over the book with a look of total disapproval, tail flicking
cards.backgroundScene: A quiet cloister garden with stone arches and neat herb beds
cards.flavourText: Sees all you have done. Writes it all down.

cards.name: Merlynx the Wise
cards.character: An ancient long-bearded grey lynx wizard in a star-covered royal-blue robe and a tall pointed hat, holding a gnarled staff
cards.poseAndExpression: Conjuring a swirl of gold stars from one paw, one eyebrow raised
cards.backgroundScene: A cluttered round tower study with scrolls, potions and a brass orrery
cards.flavourText: Saw this card coming. Has already forgiven you.

cards.name: Page Boy Pounce
cards.character: A small orange kitten page in a blue and gold tabard and a feathered cap, holding a scroll
cards.poseAndExpression: Sprinting flat out mid-leap, scroll in mouth, ears flat back
cards.backgroundScene: A winding castle staircase with torches and tapestries
cards.flavourText: Delivers messages quickly, then knocks them off the table.

cards.name: Duchess Velvet Paws
cards.character: A slender smoke-grey Russian Blue cat duchess in a crimson gown with a tall pointed hennin veil
cards.poseAndExpression: Sipping from a golden goblet, eyes sliding sideways with a knowing smile
cards.backgroundScene: A candlelit castle gallery with whispering courtiers in the shadows
cards.flavourText: Three husbands. Three accidents. One very good alibi.

cards.name: Sir Cattimore the Round
cards.character: A very fat orange cat knight whose plate armour barely closes, with a chicken leg in one paw
cards.poseAndExpression: Riding a tiny exhausted donkey, chewing happily, visor up
cards.backgroundScene: A dusty country road beside a roadside inn with a hanging sign
cards.flavourText: Undefeated at the banquet table. Rarely seen anywhere else.

cards.name: Executioner Hush
cards.character: A huge silent charcoal cat in a black hood with eye holes, carrying a very large wooden mallet
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing perfectly still with arms folded, staring straight ahead
cards.backgroundScene: A foggy castle courtyard with a stone wall and a single raven
cards.flavourText: Nobody knows who he is. Everybody moves out of his sunbeam.

cards.name: Minstrel Yowlin' Wyn
cards.character: A scruffy tuxedo cat minstrel in a patched green tunic with a feathered cap and a lute
cards.poseAndExpression: Singing at full volume with eyes shut and mouth wide, plucking the lute
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit castle wall below an open window, with an old boot flying past
cards.flavourText: Sings under your window at three in the morning, as a service.

cards.name: Abbot Snoozewell
cards.character: An elderly white monk cat in a heavy black habit with a large copper tonsure patch
cards.poseAndExpression: Asleep upright in a carved choir stall, with a small bubble at his nose
cards.backgroundScene: A dim abbey choir with tall candles and carved stone saints
cards.flavourText: Prays for eighteen hours a day, with his eyes closed.

cards.name: Lady Guinevere Longtail
cards.character: A graceful silver tabby lady in a pale blue gown and a gold circlet, with an extremely long tail
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning from a tower window with her tail hanging down to the ground like a rope
cards.backgroundScene: A tall castle tower above a rose garden, with a knight cat climbing the tail
cards.flavourText: Nobody climbs this tail without an appointment.

cards.name: Sir Hiss-a-Lot
cards.character: A bristling puffed-up tortoiseshell knight in mismatched armour with a very small sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Arched up on tiptoes with his fur on end, hissing at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A narrow wooden bridge over a stream with a bored goose nearby
cards.flavourText: Lost his only duel to a cucumber.

cards.name: Falconer Featherbane
cards.character: A sharp-eyed Bengal cat falconer in a leather jerkin with a heavy gauntlet and a nervous falcon on it
cards.poseAndExpression: Staring hungrily at the falcon on his wrist, licking his lips
cards.backgroundScene: A windswept hillside with a distant castle and flat, swirling clouds
cards.flavourText: Has lost eleven falcons. Not one of them flew away.

cards.name: Treasurer Goldpaw
cards.character: A narrow-faced thin grey cat in a dark robe with a chain of gold keys and an abacus
cards.poseAndExpression: Pushing a single coin off the edge of a desk with one claw, staring at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: A stone counting house with chests of coins and stacks of ledgers
cards.flavourText: The royal treasure is safe. It is mostly under the bed.

cards.name: Sir Lancelittle
cards.character: A tiny kitten knight in full plate armour far too big, with a lance three times his length
cards.poseAndExpression: Wobbling on a very fat hen as a steed, lance drooping, determined stare
cards.backgroundScene: A jousting list with a laughing crowd under striped canopies
cards.flavourText: What he lacks in height, he also lacks in reach.

cards.name: Princess Pouncealot
cards.character: A young tawny cat princess in a crimson gown with a small crown askew and a wooden sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaping from a banister with the sword raised and skirts flying, delighted
cards.backgroundScene: A grand castle staircase with shocked servants and a falling suit of armour
cards.flavourText: Fifth in line for the throne. Working on it.

cards.name: Thief of the Larder
cards.character: A sleek black cat rogue in a dark hood and mask with a sack over one shoulder and fish bones in his teeth
cards.poseAndExpression: Tiptoeing along a high shelf, one paw raised, eyes wide, frozen mid-step
cards.backgroundScene: A dark castle pantry with hanging hams, cheese wheels and barrels
cards.flavourText: Stole the crown jewels by accident on the way to the ham.

cards.name: Alchemist Catnippus
cards.character: A wild-eyed striped cat alchemist in a singed purple-blue robe with goggles and bubbling flasks
cards.poseAndExpression: Sniffing a smoking green flask, pupils enormous, swaying slightly
cards.backgroundScene: A vaulted cellar laboratory with copper stills and shelves of dried herbs
cards.flavourText: Sought the secret of gold. Found catnip. Stopped looking.

cards.name: Sir Gawain the Grumpy
cards.character: A flat-faced grey Persian knight in heavy gold-trimmed plate with a permanent scowl
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting on a mounting block with arms crossed, sword across his knees, glaring
cards.backgroundScene: A rainy castle courtyard with one small puddle and a soggy banner
cards.flavourText: Has been in a bad mood since the Third Crusade.

cards.name: Royal Food Taster Nibbs
cards.character: A plump anxious brown tabby in a crimson and gold servant's tabard with a silver spoon
cards.poseAndExpression: Tasting from a huge silver platter while eyeing the nobles nervously
cards.backgroundScene: A long royal banquet table piled with roast fish and pies
cards.flavourText: It is a dangerous job. He has asked for more of it.

cards.name: Gatekeeper Old Tom
cards.character: A battered one-eared old ginger tom guard in rusty chain mail with a tall halberd and a ring of keys
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning on the halberd beside an open door, looking in and then out again
cards.backgroundScene: A huge castle gatehouse with a raised portcullis and a drawbridge
cards.flavourText: Wants in. Wants out. Wants in. The gate has not shut since spring.

cards.name: Bishop Bartholomew Bigwhiskers
cards.character: A dignified long-whiskered white and black cat bishop in gold-embroidered vestments with a tall mitre and crook
cards.poseAndExpression: Giving a solemn blessing with one paw, whiskers spread magnificently
cards.backgroundScene: A soaring cathedral nave with rose windows casting flat coloured light
cards.flavourText: Blesses the faithful, then knocks over the holy water.

cards.name: Lord Reginald Fishbone
cards.character: A scrawny, proud cat lord in a threadbare crimson doublet, a chipped coronet and a fish-bone brooch
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding up one paw in lofty refusal of a crust of bread, ribs showing
cards.backgroundScene: A crumbling manor hall with holes in the roof and one sad tapestry
cards.flavourText: His lands are vast. They are mostly bog.

cards.name: Lady Foldington
cards.character: A round-faced Scottish fold cat lady with tiny folded ears, a tall headdress and a brocade gown
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering down her nose from a carriage window, ears flat, mildly appalled
cards.backgroundScene: A muddy village street with a fine gilded carriage and staring peasants
cards.flavourText: The ears are folded in permanent disapproval.

cards.name: Sir Tristan Tailchaser
cards.character: A young lean cream tabby knight in light armour with a crimson plume, tail held in one gauntlet
cards.poseAndExpression: Spinning in circles mid-charge, staring at his own tail with deep suspicion
cards.backgroundScene: A tournament field with an astonished opponent cat knight on horseback
cards.flavourText: Finally caught his nemesis. It was attached.

cards.name: The Dragon-Slayer Cat
cards.character: A broad, heroic marmalade cat in gleaming gold and silver armour with a blue cape and a notched sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing with one foot on a sleeping small green dragon, using it as a warm bed
cards.backgroundScene: A smoking mountain cave entrance littered with gold coins and helmets
cards.flavourText: Did not slay the dragon. Just made it move over.

cards.name: Peasant Muddypaws
cards.character: A scruffy mud-splattered tabby peasant in a sackcloth tunic with a wooden rake
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing ankle deep in a muddy field, glaring at the viewer, shaking one paw dry
cards.backgroundScene: A flat strip-farmed medieval field with a distant castle and a grey sky
cards.flavourText: Pays a tax of one mouse a month. Disputes the size of the mouse.

cards.name: Ratcatcher General
cards.character: A stocky scarred tabby in a battered steel helmet with medals on a leather sash and a very small map
cards.poseAndExpression: Pointing at a tiny map with a dagger, one eye closed, barking orders
cards.backgroundScene: A torchlit castle cellar with barrels and very nervous tiny rat eyes in the dark
cards.flavourText: Has won every war he has ever declared on a mouse.

cards.name: Queen Maine the Coon
cards.character: A gigantic shaggy brown Maine Coon warrior queen in bronze-trimmed armour with a fur cloak and a battle axe
cards.poseAndExpression: Towering over tiny cat soldiers, axe on one shoulder, calm and amused
cards.backgroundScene: A snowy northern fortress with banners whipping in the wind
cards.flavourText: Her army numbers one. It has always been enough.

cards.name: Scribe Inkpaw
cards.character: A meek bespectacled grey and white cat scribe in a brown robe with a quill and ink-stained paws
cards.poseAndExpression: Bent over a manuscript, a trail of inky paw prints running right across the page
cards.backgroundScene: A monastery scriptorium with sloped desks and bright illuminated pages
cards.flavourText: Every illuminated manuscript has one mistake. His are paw-shaped.

cards.name: Pirate Knight Sir Barnacle
cards.character: A salt-crusted grey cat knight with an eye patch, rusty armour with barnacles and a fish on his sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on a small wooden rowboat, sword raised, soaking wet and furious
cards.backgroundScene: A choppy flat-painted sea with stylised waves and a distant castle
cards.flavourText: Hates the water. Chose this life to spite it.

cards.name: Lady Isolde Moonwhisker
cards.character: An ethereal pale grey cat lady in a dark blue gown scattered with silver stars and a long silver veil
cards.poseAndExpression: Standing on a rooftop, gazing up at the moon, tail curled, and quietly yowling
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit castle rooftop with chimneys, stars and a huge pale moon
cards.flavourText: Her song has ended three wars and started four.

cards.name: Sir Boots the Unshod
cards.character: A tuxedo cat knight with white socks, wearing full plate armour except for his bare paws
cards.poseAndExpression: Stepping daintily through a puddle, one paw shaken high in disgust
cards.backgroundScene: A rainy road with a wooden signpost and a muddy ditch
cards.flavourText: Won't wear the boots. Won't discuss the boots.

cards.name: Hermit of the Crate Keep
cards.character: A wise, shaggy old grey cat hermit in a rough hooded robe, sitting in a small keep made of a wooden crate
cards.poseAndExpression: Squeezed tightly inside the crate with only his head showing, serene
cards.backgroundScene: A lonely misty hilltop with a single twisted tree and a far-off castle
cards.flavourText: If it fits, he sits. So say the ancient scrolls.

cards.name: Crown Prince Fluffbottom
cards.character: A vain young long-haired golden cat prince in a blue doublet with a small crown and enormous fluffy trousers of fur
cards.poseAndExpression: Admiring himself in a polished shield, turning to check his rear, pleased
cards.backgroundScene: A royal dressing room with velvet drapes and a fussing servant cat
cards.flavourText: Will one day rule. Has already chosen the mirror.

cards.name: Sir Pounce de Lion
cards.character: A cat knight with a huge home-made mane of straw tied round his head, in gold armour with a lion shield
cards.poseAndExpression: Roaring silently with mouth wide open and chest out, mane slipping sideways
cards.backgroundScene: A golden tournament field with heraldic lion banners and a yawning crowd
cards.flavourText: Fools no one. Terrifies everyone anyway.

cards.name: Sir Mordecat the Traitor
cards.character: A thin sneering dark grey cat knight in black and crimson armour with a hidden dagger behind his back
cards.poseAndExpression: Bowing low to an unseen king, smiling with all his teeth, dagger gripped behind him
cards.backgroundScene: A shadowy throne room behind a pillar, with torches and a long red carpet
cards.flavourText: Swore loyalty on Tuesday. It is now Wednesday.

cards.name: The Green Knight
cards.character: A giant moss-green furred cat knight in green leaf armour with a tail of ivy and a great axe of wood and gold
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding his helmet under one arm, staring knowingly at the viewer
cards.backgroundScene: An ancient forest chapel overgrown with flat green vines and white flowers
cards.flavourText: Offers a game with one rule: you go first.

cards.name: Grand Vizier Slink
cards.character: A long thin Oriental cat vizier in a tall dark hat and black and gold robes, with huge ears and a scroll of plots
cards.poseAndExpression: Whispering into an unseen king's ear from behind a curtain, eyes gleaming
cards.backgroundScene: A curtained royal chamber with gold lamps and hidden doors
cards.flavourText: Everything he advises is for your own good. Everything.

cards.name: Knight Errant Sir Stray
cards.character: A scruffy, one-eyed brown cat knight in patched-up armour made of pots and pans, with a dented cooking-pot helmet
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting by a small campfire, cooking a fish on his sword, quietly content
cards.backgroundScene: A lonely moonlit roadside camp with an old horse and a crooked milestone
cards.flavourText: Has no lord, no lands, no home. Also, no regrets.

cards.name: Arthur, the Once and Future Cat
cards.character: A majestic golden-maned tabby king in silver armour with a blue and gold cloak, a gleaming crown and a glowing sword
cards.poseAndExpression: Pulling a shining sword from a stone with one paw, while looking bored and yawning
cards.backgroundScene: A misty sacred lake and standing stones, with a golden sunrise and a far castle on a hill
cards.flavourText: He will return when the realm needs him, or at feeding time.
